# WAVE Runtime Registry

## What this is
A curated registry of dsh-plugin ecosystem repos. Each entry carries a verdict (HARVEST / TRACK / AB
USE / NOISE) so adopters can route around abuse and toward value. This is not a package manager — it
's an index of record. (Feeding WAVE's dispatch routing is on the roadmap, not yet wired.)

GitHub Actions runs `node bin/verify.mjs` on every push and PR to `main`.
